intro: In Stormwind City, Rema Schneider works from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. She is a human citizen who often helps local shopkeepers and artisans with trade deliveries.

p: Rema Schneider manages daily trade from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. The shop stands just west of the stone bridge into Cathedral Square, along Stormwind's canals. Cloth and finished garments move between local craftsmen, and Rema relies on helpful couriers to carry supplies between workshops.
